The main ingredients in bread are flour, water, yeast, and salt.

The sun dipped below the horizon, casting long, bruised shadows across the shoreline. Clara stood motionless, her silhouette stark against the vibrant hues of dusk as they bled into the churning ocean. In her hand, she clutched the old, tattered hat she had found in the attic—her father's. The fabric was worn thin, the brim frayed, yet each fiber seemed to carry a memory: a piece of laughter, a whisper of song, from a time before grief had wrapped its cold fingers around her family. She pressed the hat to her chest, trying to hold onto the warmth that was no longer there, while the tide rolled in, indifferent and endless.
